thread:
morgan: Hey team — planning a short pin window tonight 22:00 UTC for runtime 3.2 -> temporary pin to mitigate KV-cache regression with quant models. Need quick compat check + signoff. Target window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Action: deploy-bot will pin runtime 3.2 for model group "quant-v4, llama3q". Can folks verify SDK compatibility (sdk-js & sdk-py) by 21:30 UTC? /cc @anya @luis @sam

deploy-bot: Scheduled pin request received by morgan. ETA execution 22:00 UTC. Command: /deploy pin runtime=3.2 models="quant-v4,llama3q" rollback-window=60m

anya: On it, will run upgraded integration tests against sdk-js@2.7.x and sdk-py@3.1.7. Quick Q: will this affect hosted fallback routing?

morgan: nope — routing policy unchanged, only runtime pin so hosted requests still route if compatible. fallback remains to runtime 3.1 if necessary.

luis: FYI we saw a perf regression at scale on quant-v4 with runtime 3.2 in perf-run #546 yesterday — increased tail-latency for long-seq. I can reproduce locally with sample script. I'll post logs.

luis: pasted log:
```
2026-03-20T18:04:12Z worker-12 WARN kvcache miss-rate 0.48
2026-03-20T18:04:12Z worker-12 INFO batch-size 8 -> latency 1.24s -> 1.95s
```

qa-bot: sdk-js integration tests: 12/120 failing (mostly gen tests with long-seq). sdk-py: 0/98 failing. Full matrix scheduled at 21:10 UTC.

sam: If JS tests failing, we need to decide: proceed with pin (prevents 3.2 from serving) or delay. What's the risk matrix? propose: proceed with pin but enable canary flag for eu-west to observe for 10m then expand.

rohit: Add to release notes: "Temporary runtime pin 3.2 applied for quant workloads. Customers routed to compatible runtime 3.1 for affected model variants." I'll draft blurb.

anya: Quick compatibility note: sdk-js@2.7.x relies on new runtime kernel arg that 3.2 changed; patch in sdk-js fix will be ready by 21:45 UTC. If fix lands, we can unpin after QA signoff.

morgan: Decision timeline: at 21:50 UTC — if sdk-js fix present + QA green -> no pin. If not -> schedule pin at 22:00 UTC with staggered rollout (10m eu-west canary). Everyone ack?

sam: ack

anya: ack

luis: ack, will keep perf probe running

deploy-bot: morgan requested pin but not executed. Current state: pending. Execution window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. Use /deploy execute pin --id=5101010101 if approved.

qa-bot: Final test summary at 21:36 UTC: sdk-js now 118/120 pass (2 flaky left), sdk-py all pass. Long-seq e2e still flaky in eu-west sim.

morgan: Given fixes landed and QA mostly green, postpone pin. We'll hold scheduled pin but keep rollback plan ready. Reassign roll-call: @luis monitor perf 22:00-22:30, @sam prepare rollback playbook. If tail-latency > 2s for >3% queries in 10min, trigger rollback.

sam: noted, I'll be on standby at 22:00.

luis: will alert on slack and trigger auto-metric alert if threshold hit.

deploy-bot: Scheduled pin canceled by morgan. Reason: QA + SDK fixes landed. Will keep pending entry for 2 hours in case of rapid rehearse.

rohit: Draft release note snippet: "- Temporary pin scheduled for runtime 3.2 on quant-v4/llama3q was canceled after SDK fixes. Monitored for regressions. Contact support if you see anomalies."

morgan: thanks all. Closing thread unless we need to reopen. Leaving action items: luis perf probe, sam rollback readiness, anya ship sdk quick patch to main. /cc @everyone
